items.question: Under the Abu Dhabi Early Childhood Authority (ECA), up to what age in years is a child considered to be in early childhood?
items.gold: Early childhood runs from conception until the child reaches eight years.
items.fact: ECA defines early childhood ending at age eight years

items.question: How many hours of reduced working time per day are working mothers in the federal government entitled to for nursing their child?
items.gold: Two hours, at the beginning or end of working hours, fully paid.
items.fact: Federal working mothers get two paid nursing hours daily
